title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.72
summary: Fix stale HLS video replay with monotonic live segment checks and snapshot freshness watchdog.
changes: Detect stale HLS sequence despite active buffered video playback
Prevent old cached frames from marking recovered HLS playback as connected
Reconnect only stalled active viewer with a 45-second cooldown
Stop manufacturing fresh-looking snapshot HLS frames from last image after 15 seconds without successful fetch
Retain stable go2rtc broker and 26-camera fair startup
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.72
description: Live HLS sequence freshness and bounded snapshot fallback frames
releaseNotes: Fix cached HLS fragments endlessly showing as live images. Check segment sequence every 2.5s, reconnect only the affected active browser player after 30s stale and at most once per 45s, and bound stale snapshot JPEG repetition to 15s. No database/.env changes. Maintains 2.20.71 startup speed and fixed go2rtc broker.
